SELECT s.id, s.subject_code, s.subject_name, s.status, s.sort_no, s.updated_by, s.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) FROM ding_employee e WHERE e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.status = 'ENABLED' AND ( s.all_employee_visible = 1 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subject_permission p WHERE p.subject_id = s.id AND p.target_type = 'USER' AND p.target_corp_code = e.corp_code AND p.target_id = e.ding_user_id AND p.permission_effect = 'ALLOW' AND p.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.deleted = 0 ) )) AS employee_count, (SELECT t.id FROM invoice_title_subject its INNER JOIN invoice_title t ON t.id = its.title_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE its.subject_id = s.id ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 0 WHEN t.status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS bound_title_id, (SELECT t.company_name FROM invoice_title_subject its INNER JOIN invoice_title t ON t.id = its.title_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE its.subject_id = s.id ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 0 WHEN t.status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS bound_title_name FROM invoice_subject s
ORDER BY s.sort_no ASC, s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, subject_code, subject_name, status, sort_no, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM invoice_subject WHERE subject_code = #{subjectCode} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, subject_code, subject_name, status, sort_no, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM invoice_subject WHERE subject_name = #{subjectName} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, subject_code, subject_name, status, all_employee_visible, sort_no, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM invoice_subject WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, subject_code, subject_name, status, sort_no, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM invoice_subject WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, subject_code, subject_name, status, sort_no, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM invoice_subject WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoice_subject (subject_code, subject_name, status, sort_no, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{subjectCode}, #{subjectName}, #{status}, #{sortNo}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE invoice_subject SET subject_code = #{subjectCode}, subject_name = #{subjectName}, status = #{status}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE invoice_subject SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE invoice_subject SET all_employee_visible = #{allEmployeeVisible}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
